title: AI-Generated Course Builder Database — Overview and definition
body: Signature edition. Original Signature methods, framings, and analyses developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout; never mixed with public-harvest records. Course outlines, lessons, exercises, rubrics, and alignment checks for AI-built courses. The AI-Generated Course Builder Database documents courses built by AI, done right: outlines with learning objectives, lessons with real content, exercises with solutions, rubrics for assessment, and alignment checks proving the exercises actually test the objectives. AI can generate a course in minutes — and generate a bad one just as fast. Each record includes the quality gates (accuracy review, alignment verification, difficulty calibration) that separate generated courses from generated content.

title: AI-Generated Course Builder Database — Knowledge: technical reference
body: Signature edition. Original Signature methods, framings, and analyses developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout; never mixed with public-harvest records. Course anatomy: OBJECTIVES (measurable: 'student can compute...' not 'understand...'; Bloom's levels) -> OUTLINE (modules ordered by the dependency graph) -> LESSONS (content per objective, accuracy-reviewed) -> EXERCISES (items per objective with solutions and difficulty tags) -> RUBRICS (criteria per objective) -> ALIGNMENT CHECK (coverage matrix: objectives x exercises; gaps flagged) -> REVIEW (accuracy, pedagogy, difficulty). Generation workflow: draft -> accuracy review (subject expert) -> alignment verification (automated) -> difficulty calibration (pilot or estimation) -> publish with quality log. Quality gates: no lesson ships unreviewed; no objective ships untested; no exercise ships without a solution. Bloom's taxonomy: remember < understand < apply < analyze < evaluate < create — objectives and items tagged by level.

demo.title: Execution: Bayesian knowledge tracing update
demo.code: let pL=0.3;const pT=0.2,pS=0.1,pG=0.25;function update(correct){const pC=pL*(1-pS)+(1-pL)*pG;const pLgiven=correct?(pL*(1-pS)/pC):(pL*pS/(pL*pS+(1-pL)*(1-pG)));pL=pLgiven+(1-pLgiven)*pT;return pL;}const responses=[1,1,0,1,1];const traj=responses.map(update);const mastered=traj[traj.length-1]>=0.95;J({final:+traj[traj.length-1].toFixed(3),mastered});assert(traj.every(v=>v>=0&&v<=1),'bkt-range');assert(traj[traj.length-1]>0.3,'bkt-learn');

demo.title: Verification: concept graph is a DAG
demo.code: const edges=[['arith','algebra'],['algebra','deriv'],['deriv','backprop']];const nodes=[...new Set(edges.flat())];function topo(){const indeg={};nodes.forEach(n=>indeg[n]=0);edges.forEach(([a,b])=>indeg[b]++);const q=nodes.filter(n=>indeg[n]===0);const order=[];while(q.length){const n=q.shift();order.push(n);edges.filter(e=>e[0]===n).forEach(([a,b])=>{if(--indeg[b]===0)q.push(b);});}return order;}const order=topo();J({order,isDAG:order.length===nodes.length});assert(order.length===nodes.length&&order.indexOf('arith')<order.indexOf('backprop'),'dag');

title: AI-Generated Course Builder Database — Verification: tests and limitations
body: Signature edition. Original Signature methods, framings, and analyses developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout; never mixed with public-harvest records. Tests: alignment test (gaps detected); review test (unreviewed lessons flagged); mapping test (every exercise has an objective); determinism test. Limitations: generation quality needs human review (enforced by gates); difficulty tags are estimates until piloted; pedagogy review is expert work. Every course carries its quality log.
